verdict.rationale: Orb docs mention testing pricing changes against historical usage before deploying, previewing invoice impact before saving, and running in parallel with an existing billing system to validate data before cutover—these imply some pre-production testing capability, but there is no explicit mention of a dedicated sandbox/test environment or test API keys isolated from production data. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/test-mode environment, test API keys or separate test account, confirmation that test data never touches production billing records.
